messages.content: Extract blindness facts only. Preserve the blind person and use onset_only for a stated onset, ongoing_since for explicit continuing wording, closed_interval for two endpoints, and active_on_date for an explicit dated status. A spouse's blindness is not the taxpayer's. Do not invent recovery, permanence, or the legal year-end conclusion. Every positive record needs facts evidence; complete [] is finite absence and unread uses null.
